claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense (OngoingOperation variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Tongues grants the touched creature universal language comprehension and universal intelligibility. The ongoing_effect family is the correct structural fit (timed duration, target attachment, no concentration), but OngoingOperation only covers roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. The v4 atom grant_sense exists but has no surface-level OngoingOperation variant to carry it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken or signed language that it hears or sees. Moreover, when the target communicates by speaking or signing, any creature that knows at least one language can understand it.

discrepancies: no content/tongues.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
